prompt_text: "Write a standard automated response to a customer inquiry, acknowledging their request and providing a timeframe for a team to get back to them."
email_text:
Hi Hitesh,

Thank you for writing to us. We acknowledge the request of your communication.

Please note that our team will get back to you within 24-48 business hours.

Your patience is highly appreciated.

Thanks,
Team AmbitionBox
